decks.notes: The main strategy of this deck is to ramp into powerful Eldrazi creatures while controlling the opponent's board with removal spells and disruption. The deck aims to generate a lot of mana quickly with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse to cast big threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ugin, the Eye of the Storms. Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command help to disrupt the opponent's game plan while Sowing Mycospawn can generate extra value. Overall, the deck excels at overwhelming the opponent with huge threats and efficient removal.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures along with blink effects to gain value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By constantly blinking creatures in and out of play, the deck aims to control the board while applying pressure to the opponent. Cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp are key to this strategy, allowing you to protect your creatures and re-trigger their enter-the-battlefield effects. The deck also includes disruption in the form of cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's plan while you establish your board presence.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the synergy between creatures with +1/+1 counters and sacrifice effects to generate value and disrupt the opponent. By combining cards like Sowing Mycospawn, Basking Broodscale, and Glaring Fleshraker with Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command, the deck aims to create a powerful board presence and control the game. The addition of Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End provides a late-game threat, while cards like Urza's Saga and Ancient Stirrings help to find key pieces of the combo. This deck focuses on assembling its combo pieces efficiently to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The main concept of this Aggro - Affinity Modern deck is to generate a significant amount of artifact creatures and utilize them to quickly overwhelm the opponent, employing cards like Claws of Gix, Salvage Titan, and Pinnacle Emissary alongside artifact support cards like Mox Opal and Engineered Explosives. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence and control the game with artifact synergy and efficient creature interactions, with a focus on using artifacts to disrupt the opponent's strategy while aggressively pushing for damage.

The deck focuses on utilizing Allosaurus Rider and Neoform to quickly put powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Ghalta onto the battlefield. It also includes cards like Eldritch Evolution and Summoner's Pact to tutor for key pieces of the combo. The deck is designed to efficiently ramp into big threats and overwhelm the opponent with high-powered creatures. Additionally, it includes protection in the form of Pact of Negation and Veil of Summer to ensure the combo goes off smoothly. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence early and finish the game quickly with its powerful creatures.

This deck focuses on quickly tutoring and casting Allosaurus Rider, which can be used as a sacrifice outlet to put Ghalta or Griselbrand into play. The deck utilizes a combination of neoform and eldritch evolution, alongside summoner's pact, to quickly assemble the combo pieces and win the game. The deck also includes cards like veil of summer and pact of negation to protect its combo pieces and disrupt opponents. Additionally, the deck includes tools like planar genesis and disciple of freyalise to generate value and further strengthen its board presence.

This deck aims to aggressively control the board by utilizing blink effects to repeatedly trigger powerful enter the battlefield abilities from creatures like Phelia and Overlord of the Balemurk. With cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, this deck can out-value opponents by constantly removing threats and generating incremental advantage. Fatal Push and Thoughtseize help maintain tempo and disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional utility and protection. Overall, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and value generation through blink effects.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and legendary creatures to create a powerful combo that can quickly win the game. By utilizing cards like Grinding Station, Mox Opal, and Kethis, the Hidden Hand, the deck aims to generate mana and card advantage while setting up a winning board state. Cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student help to dig for essential pieces of the combo, while disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler provide protection. The deck aims to assemble its combo quickly and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful synergies.

The deck focuses on utilizing Amulet of Vigor to quickly ramp up mana and play powerful combo cards like Primeval Titan, Scapeshift, and Urza's Saga. By effectively managing lands and utilizing cards like Arboreal Grazer and Cultivator Colossus, the deck aims to ramp up quickly and generate extremely strong board states. Additionally, the deck utilizes land-based combos like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal large amounts of damage to the opponent. The goal is to assemble the pieces of the combo quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence.

The deck focuses on filling the graveyard with creatures like Street Wraith and Shardless Agent, then using cards like Violent Outburst and Living End to bring them back onto the battlefield all at once, overwhelming the opponent with a sudden surge of powerful creatures. The deck also includes cards like Force of Negation to help protect the combo, while utilizing cards like Endurance and Subtlety for disruption and control. The key strategy is to set up the perfect graveyard and timing to unleash a game-winning Living End.

This deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures with abilities that can combo off each other to generate massive amounts of mana and overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of threats. The key strategy involves tutoring for the right creatures using Green Sun's Zenith, while utilizing cards like Devoted Druid and Vizier of Remedies to generate infinite mana loops. Leyline of Abundance and Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler provide additional support for ramp and creature buffs, while Walking Ballista serves as a finisher. Agatha's Soul Cauldron adds a potential win condition by draining the opponent's life total.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures from the graveyard using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. It also utilizes instant spells like Ephemerate and Faithful Mending to protect key pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to combo off in a single turn by setting up the graveyard with cards like Quantum Riddler and quickly reanimating a game-ending threat like Griselbrand. It can also control the board with removal spells like Prismatic Ending and counter spells like Force of Negation to buy time to execute its combo.

The deck utilizes a combination of card draw, self-mill, and graveyard interaction to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures such as Archon of Cruelty. By discarding and milling cards, the deck speeds up the process of getting creatures into the graveyard and then uses spells like Unearth and Persist to bring them back to the battlefield. The focus is on exploiting the graveyard as a resource, creating explosive turns that overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures early in the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifact creatures and artifacts to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a strong aggressive strategy. By utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal, along with powerful creatures like Cori-Steel Cutter and Bilbo, Thief in the Night, the deck aims to create a fast and efficient board presence. Additionally, cards like Urza's Saga and Emry, Lurker of the Loch provide additional value and card advantage. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Metallic Rebuke and Sink into Stupor to control the opponent's resources and protect its own game plan.

This Aggro - Blink deck focuses on utilizing blink effects to repeatedly trigger powerful abilities on creatures, such as Emperor of Bones and Quantum Riddler, to control the board and apply pressure to the opponent. It combines aggressive creatures with disruptive spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to maintain tempo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes utility lands like Undercity Sewers and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler to further enhance its game plan. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive effects.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with a mix of aggressive creatures and spells. By using efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Solitude, along with powerful spells like Thraben Charm and Quantum Riddler, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents. Utilizing cards like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment for removal, as well as Ephemerate for protection, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while controlling the board. By utilizing the Jeskai color combination of white, blue, and red, the deck can adapt to various threats and strategies in the Modern format.
